concepts.label: Full-Text Search (Couchbase Lite)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - local, SQLite-FTS-backed search over an FTS index, invoked via the SQL++ match()/RANK() functions or via FullTextFunction.match() in QueryBuilder; unlike server/'s FTS this runs entirely on-device with no separate Search Service

concepts.label: Full-Text Index (Couchbase Lite)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - created via FullTextIndexConfiguration or IndexBuilder.fullTextIndex(); mandatory before running an FTS query, unlike a regular value query

relations.evidence: To run a full-text search (FTS) query, you must create a full-text index on the expression being matched. Unlike regular queries, the index is not optional.

cross_product_finding: FTS in Couchbase Lite is entirely local: no Search Service dependency, no cluster-level index-manage privilege, no edition gate mentioned on this page (contrast with Predictive Query and Delta Sync elsewhere in this batch, which are explicitly Enterprise Edition-gated). The mandatory-index requirement is a functional constraint of the SQLite FTS engine, not an access-control or licensing decision - a genuinely new relation shape (requiresIndex) that has no counterpart in the privilege/role/billing-gate vocabulary from server/ or Capella.
notable_absence: No dependsOnService relation applies here - there is no separate 'FTS service' to depend on, unlike server/'s Search Service architecture (as referenced by server/'s and Capella's presumed FTS-service concepts).
